name: load_reference
description: Load a reference image you want the model to match, from a disk `path` (desktop) or a `data_url`. It is stored so compare_reference can score against it, and best-effort pinned behind the model in the viewport. Usually the user drops the reference into the MCP Copilot panel instead (then just use get_reference) — use this when you have a file path or image data yourself.

overlay.description: Pin it in the viewport (default true; non-fatal if unsupported).
